title: Algolia webcomponents
body:
<!--
  Thanks for participating in this project! We will try to answer as soon as possible 🙏
-->

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe 🙏**
We're using Algolia in a 'classic frontend' (Magento 2) with webcomponents, and thus can't just implement a vue/react component set. We do like all the automatic updating of elements when search queries change. We're essentially looking for a lit-html port of the vue/react libraries.

**Describe the solution you'd like 🤔**
We'd like to have that in a set of proper webcomponents. We're using lit-html ourselves to easily build webcomponents, but we're not really bound to a specific webcomponent library. 

**Describe alternatives you've considered ✨**
We've used the Magento 2 implementation, but since it uses mustache and other custom bindings it essentially becomes its own render pipeline, having multiple render pipelines in the same system costs extra and isn't preferably.

There are some other webcomponents that implement algolia but are usually _very_ limited and don't suit our needs.
